title: Exact Coin Reachability
summary: Return whether reusable coins can form amount exactly.
statement: Return whether reusable coins can form amount exactly. Implement `exact_coin_reachability` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: An amount is reachable when subtracting one allowed coin reaches a known state.
Build a boolean table from zero through the target.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the exact_coin_reachability invariant is complete.
Editorial: Build a boolean table from zero through the target. The intended bounds are O(amount·coins) time and O(amount) space.
editorial: An amount is reachable when subtracting one allowed coin reaches a known state. Build a boolean table from zero through the target. This yields O(amount·coins) time and O(amount) auxiliary space.

tests.explanation: One 4-value coin plus one 7-value coin reaches 11 exactly.
Any sum of reusable 2s and 4s is even, so 7 is unreachable.
